description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified resource in a specified instance
description_zh: 获取指定实例下指定资源的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice get-instance-resource --instance-id pairec-cn-test1 --resource-id reso-2s416t000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInstanceResource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2411819.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

Group.description_en:
The resource group.

If the resource category is DataManagement, valid values are:
storage
modelpipeline
datastorage
modeltrain

If the resource category is Engine, valid values are:
feature
predict
recall
recengine

If the resource category is Monitor, valid values are:
logs
logsback
coldstart
deploy
